name: Kit

intro.text: {player}! Glastonbury! I've had three cups of something herbal and I can see colours I didn't know about.
I'm not with the Enclosure any more, but I'm still going to beat you. That's just friendship.

win: Okay, that went badly. For me. Brilliantly for you. I'll put it in the blooper reel.
after: The Green Man thing up there is real, isn't it? I felt it in my teeth.
